resources.string: Books play from this location. Keep the files available.
Could not read these files. Check that they are available, then try again.
These files cannot be played from this location. Move them to a folder on your device, then select them again.
Could not keep access to these files. Choose a folder on your device and try again.
Some book details are missing. You can try Read metadata in Audio files.
Read all linked audio to enable matching for progress transfer and reconnecting a moved file. This can take time. Playback will pause. Sources are never changed.

Select the original audio files. Their full contents must match the previously verified audio. Progress, notes, and edits are kept. Files that were never verified cannot be matched to a new location after the original is lost.
Verify the original linked audio before matching it to another location. If the original is gone, keep this entry for its notes and add the new audio separately.
Remove this book, its progress, bookmarks, and notes? The linked source files will remain untouched.
Verify audio in Audio files before exporting or matching progress. This reads the full audio files.
Existing tracks, order, progress, notes, and edits are kept. New files are added only after review.
Could not finish checking this folder. Existing tracks, progress, and notes are kept. Make the source available and try again.
Add these files after the existing tracks. Their order and all saved progress, notes, and edits are kept. A loaded book will pause while its playlist updates.
Read the audio files for missing covers, chapters, and book details. If this book is in the player, playback will pause. Your progress, bookmarks, and edits are kept.
Could not read all the book details. Check that the files are available, then try again. Your progress, bookmarks, and edits are kept.
